sens_en: to burn, to cook, to heat
origine_fr: Le feu 火 et 尧, qui donnait le son ; lu yáo, il ne donne pas celui de shāo. Le feu reste à gauche. 烧, c'est brûler, cuire, chauffer.
origine_en: Fire 火 and 尧, which gave the sound; read yáo, it does not match shāo. The fire stays on the left. 烧 means to burn, to cook, to heat.

phrase.pinyin: Háizi fāshāo le, yào qù yīyuàn.
phrase.fr: L'enfant a de la fièvre, il faut aller à l'hôpital.
phrase.en: The child has a fever and needs to go to hospital.
